title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Tea Party on 1969-12-30

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of a solid, contemplative set with standout Black Peter and New Speedway, though some segue portions are missing.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear soundboard source and a unique, thoughtful performance highlighted by superb renditions of Black Peter and New Speedway. While most listeners find the show engaging, a few note that it feels sleepy and point out missing audio at the transitions from The Other One to Cosmic Charlie and from Dark Star into Alligator, which slightly mars an otherwise strong set.

ai_rating.rationale: Two reviewers rate the show highly (5 & 4 stars) praising both performance and soundboard quality, while one gives a lukewarm 3‑star rating calling it dull; overall average ~4 ★ with detailed comments supporting a medium confidence level.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally high‑fidelity soundboard recording, but missing the last 15–20 seconds of The Other One and portions at the Dark Star → Alligator segue.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A contemplative, pre‑dawn vibe with smooth transitions overall; however, missing audio in a few segues disrupts the flow for some listeners.
